user.title: HomeWizard Dashboard
user.description: Adds a HomeWizard-style panel to the sidebar. HomeWizard devices are detected automatically; prices and other options can be set later via Configure.

init.title: HomeWizard Dashboard
init.description: Changes apply immediately; reload the panel in your browser or app afterwards.

data.prijs_kwh: Fixed price (only used without cost statistics in the Energy dashboard)
data.saldering: Net metering (feed-in at the same price)
data.solar_counter: Solar kWh meter counter used for production

data_description.prijs_kwh: Costs preferably come from the HA Energy dashboard. This price is the fallback.
data_description.overrides: E.g. {"solar": [...]}. Leave empty for automatic detection.
data_description.stroom_totaal: Automatic: net metering until end of 2026, import and export separately from 1 Jan 2027.
data_description.jaar_start_dag: E.g. 1 and 4 for a contract year from 1 April; the year view then shows 2026/2027.
data_description.thema: Default for everyone. The sun/moon button in the panel overrides it per device.
